A2.reason: Needs 3 consecutive full 14-bookmaker runs (startup, scheduled, or a full admin scrape) of the merged code; each persists to the DB. EXECUTION rules 3-4.
A2.precondition: recovery/integration (which contains recovery/betcris) is merged into master in the main checkout. The dev server restarts and its startup run is the first full run.
A2.when: Right after the merge, plus the next two full runs. Count only full 14-bookmaker runs (startup, scheduled, or the admin scrape below without a bookmakers filter); never a betcris-only scrape.
A2.optionalFullScrape: curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer dev-api-key" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"league":"premier-league"}' http://localhost:3001/api/admin/scrape
perRunCommands: sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' <server log> | grep -E '\[Aggregator/FullOffer\] betcris ([a-z_]+:|scraper threw|save threw)|\[Betcris\] (No WebSocket|capture ok)|\[ScrapeHelpers\] betcris:|\[Betcris/FullOffer\] (Found [0-9]+ games|Skipped game|Aborting per-match loop)|\[Betcris/Navigation\] (Capture attempt|[a-z-]+ deadline fired)'
sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' <server log> | grep -oE '\[Betcris/FullOffer\] (Skipped game|Aborting per-match loop)|\[Betcris/Navigation\] (Capture attempt|[a-z-]+ deadline fired)' | sort | uniq -c
A2.unmappedSummaryGrep: grep -E '^\[ScrapeHelpers\] [a-z]+: [0-9]+ unmapped market ids, [0-9]+ OTHER markets this run \(top: ' <server log>
expectedPerRun: exactly one '[Betcris] capture ok: navMs=..., wsOpenMs=..., firstUsefulFrameMs=..., attempts=..., loopLagMaxMs=..., finalUrl=...' line for the listing; record firstUsefulFrameMs, attempts and loopLagMaxMs; flag firstUsefulFrameMs > 12000 (standalone reference 1742 / 1 / 23)

one '[Aggregator/FullOffer] betcris success: N matches, M markets found, S saved' line (aggregator.ts formatOutcomeLine) with N >= ceil(0.9 * G), G from the same run's '[Betcris/FullOffer] Found G games' line (18 of 20, 18 of 19)
exactly one '[ScrapeHelpers] betcris: X unmapped market ids, Y OTHER markets this run (top: ...)' line; none of the 26 ladder ids in its top list
no '[Betcris/FullOffer] Aborting per-match loop: ...' line and no '[Aggregator/FullOffer] betcris scraper threw:' or '[Aggregator/FullOffer] betcris save threw:' line
few or no '[Betcris/FullOffer] Skipped game <id> (<home> vs <away>): No WebSocket data captured: <failure> (...)' lines, each with a classified reason (only target_game_missing is game-level)
any failure line has the classified form '[Betcris] No WebSocket data captured: <failure> (attempts=..., ..., title="...", finalUrl=..., loopLagMaxMs=...)'
record the uniq -c counts of Skipped game / Aborting / Capture attempt / <name> deadline fired lines; a 'deadline fired N ms late' line, with loopLagMaxMs, is the live evidence for the stall grace
pass = 3 consecutive passing runs. The betters/lebull/pzbuk/totalbet migrations are already in recovery/integration, so these runs carry their contention and no extra repeat is needed

ladder_peer_check.py: 'SWAP_SUSPECT []' and 'LADDER_PEER_CHECK PASS []' (exit 0); a game without team ladders prints no label lines and 'PASS []'

a FAIL caused only by a SWAP_SUSPECT label may be cleared by hand when the same side's other family fits its own side (TEAM_TOTAL_SHOTS against TEAM_TOTAL_SHOTS_ON_TARGET of the same side; FOULS against OFFSIDES or THROW_INS); record both labels' numbers
health.py 'UNKNOWN/OTHER rows' is not a criterion

peerCheck.scope: Controller ruling 12. The 5 side-less totals (FOULS_TOTAL, TOTAL_SHOTS_ON_TARGET, THROW_INS_TOTAL, OFFSIDES_TOTAL, HALF_TIME_TOTAL_SHOTS_ON_TARGET) against the peer median on the same line, and each side of the 10 side-scoped team ladders (HOME_/AWAY_TEAM_TOTAL_FOULS, HOME_/AWAY_TEAM_TOTAL_OFFSIDES, HOME_/AWAY_TEAM_TOTAL_THROW_INS, TEAM_TOTAL_SHOTS HOME:/AWAY:, TEAM_TOTAL_SHOTS_ON_TARGET HOME:/AWAY:) against the same side of the peers and against the peers' opposite side at the same line. FAIL: a label's median deviation beyond +-15%, a line beyond +-25%, or a SWAP_SUSPECT (the opposite side fits better by more than 5 points). A swap is visible where the peers' two sides differ by more than that margin.

offlineTest.inputs: Leeds United - Tottenham Hotspur (31333513), 2026-11-07: peer rows from the live API (GET /normalized-markets at 01:36Z, master, no betcris ladder rows) merged with the betcris rows of the offline proxy (parser -> normalizer -> buildCategoriesWithMarketTypes) on the 01:31Z match-day dump, trimmed to the 13 ladder codes. Calibrated = every betcris OVER set to 0.95 x the same-side peer median. Swapped = every betcris side-scoped price moved to the other side.
